camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, front camera facing you with face and jaw visible.

title: Slow and Fast Chewing
summary: Chew one bite slowly and another quickly.
purpose: Cover the range of chewing speeds needed to study cadence; pace instructions are intended behaviour, never a measured rate.

request.summary: Two nods cannot be checked automatically; add a midpoint nod and one-nod prompts.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and confirm they are connected to this iPhone.
Prop the iPhone so your face and jaw are visible.
Use steady, even lighting on your face.
Stay within the camera view for the whole recording.
Prepare two similar bites of a food you can chew for 20 seconds.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera. Nod down once, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still

activities.instruction: Take a bite and chew slowly and deliberately
Stop and keep still. Nod down once, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still

activities.instruction: Take another bite and chew quickly
Finish with one downward nod, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still
